name: re2c
description: Generate C-based recognizers from regular expressions

repo.name: re2c
repo.description: Lexer generator for C, C++, D, Go, Haskell, Java, JS, OCaml, Python, Rust, Swift, V and Zig.

readme.summary: The README provides a decent high-level description but defers nearly all practical content to external links, leaving users without any in-place examples, installation steps, or usage guidance.
readme.top_issue: No quick-start example or basic usage demonstration — users must navigate to an external website to learn how to actually use the tool.

security.summary: The libre2c code appears to be generally secure, with no major injection risks or secrets exposure, but could benefit from more explicit input validation.

common_complaints: Breaking changes in minor releases (4.3.1 regression)
Critical bugs in core functionality (NULL dereference in determinization)
Incorrect DFA generation in edge cases
Missing language feature support ($ in regexp, traps after actions)
praise_themes: Proactive maintenance of language integrations (Zig examples)
sentiment.summary: re2c is actively maintained with regular releases and bug fixes, but users experience occasional regressions and some feature requests linger unfulfilled for years, indicating selective prioritization rather than comprehensive coverage.

communication.summary: The maintainer's responses are highly helpful, clear, patient, and technically deep, making them an exemplary model for open-source communication.

concerns: 0 commits in past 6 months indicating long period of inactivity
32 open issues unresolved with no closed issues in 6 months

positive_signals: Recent commit activity 3 days ago suggests possible revival
No open PRs indicate cleaner state for potential future work
maintenance.summary: Package was abandoned for 6+ months but shows a single recent commit, indicating possible revival though insufficient evidence of sustained maintenance.

changelog.summary: The changelog is well-structured and comprehensive, but lacks explicit migration guides for users to upgrade between versions.

governance.summary: The re2c project lacks a clear succession plan and decision-making process, but indicates multiple maintainers with merge rights.

analysis_summary.doc_summary: The README provides a good introduction to the package, but lacks clear installation instructions and examples for common use cases.
